title: Retail drug business practising collaborative drug therapy management need not register as a Health Facility
rule_summary: Under M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24B1/2(d), a retail drug business practicing in collaborative drug therapy management under this section shall not be required to register as a Health Facility under 105 CMR 700.004(A)(2)(d).
exam_relevance: Tests that collaborative practice in a retail drug business does not by itself require the business to register as a Health Facility under the Department's controlled substance regulations.
common_confusions: The subsection relieves the retail drug business of Health Facility registration; it says nothing about the individual pharmacist's own registration for the purpose of prescribing.
The statute states its cross-reference as 105 CMR 700.004(A)(2)(d).
verification_notes: Read in the current text of M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24B1/2 on malegislature.gov on 2026-09-17; the subsection reads as inserted by St. 2008, c. 528, s. 3.
